decision.description: Why a particular scope, tier, or approach was chosen

example.summary: Chose display proxy elimination as Batch 3C primary scope
example.lessons_learned: After dedup fix (6872a07), 4 display proxy methods have 0 remaining call sites — safe to remove entirely without updating any call sites
example.reusable_decision: Check call sites before assuming proxy methods need updating. Dedup fixes can reduce call sites to zero, making removal trivial.

failure.description: What failed, why, and which file/method was involved

example.lessons_learned: Test used mock trader without _event_producer_label or _display_* methods. After dedup fix (6872a07), test now passes — fix was unrelated to the batch.

failure_pattern.root_cause: helper called trader._event_producer_label() through indirect route; mock trader lacked the method

example.next_recommendation: When tests use mock traders, verify which methods the helper calls indirectly — if helper calls trader.* for methods that could be on self.*, dedup fix resolves the mock incompatibility.

repair.description: What repair pattern fixed what failure class

example.summary: Added hashlib import to trader_observability.py after moving _phase2_candidate_hash
example.lessons_learned: When moving a @staticmethod that uses a stdlib module (hashlib), the import must follow it to the new file

failure_pattern.root_cause: hashlib.sha1() called but hashlib not imported in helper file

repair_pattern.fix_applied: Added 'import hashlib' to trader_observability.py imports section

example.reusable_decision: Always check stdlib imports used by a @staticmethod before moving it to a new file.

tool_usage.description: Tool invocation history, success rate, known edge cases

example.summary: JSONL session scan found 443 events using PID 19480
example.lessons_learned: Filter by runtime_session_id not raw PID — PID appears in multiple JSON fields. Session ID is authoritative.
example.reusable_decision: Use runtime_session_id field for JSONL filtering, not numeric PID string match

runtime_evidence.description: Paper run results indexed by commit SHA

example.summary: Batch 3C validated: 7 cycles, exit 0, 56 orderbook events, 28 cadence events
example.lessons_learned: Display proxy removal and static utility migration do not affect JSONL telemetry shape

repository_insight.description: What has been moved where, method ownership history

example.summary: trader_observability.py now owns: display state (3A), orderbook refresh (3B-1), cadence (3B-2), static phase2 utils (3C)
example.lessons_learned: Each batch adds a labeled section to trader_observability.py. Do not mix batch artifacts — use comments like '# Batch 3C:'
example.reusable_decision: Check trader_observability.py section comments to understand what was moved in each batch

quant_safety.description: Known forbidden areas — PERMANENT, never expires

example.summary: _phase4_build_quote_lineage is PERMANENT on trader.py — never extract

forbidden_scope_notes.reason: Called from live order submission path (lines 4338, 11583, 11689). Extraction creates execution-path coupling to helper.

agent_skill.description: Which agent role performed well on which task type

example.summary: Role 29 gate check: PROCEED verdict, 0 escalations, 4 context reads
example.lessons_learned: For gate checks, Role 29 needs: gate check design + trader.py grep + loop memory. Typically 4 reads.
example.reusable_decision: Assign Role 29 to all Class 2 gate check tasks. Use 4 context reads: active state + task queue + loop memory + gate design doc.
